end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere through three-dimensional shape practice.
Matched everyday objects to their 3D shapes, including dice, bread packet, matchbox and ice-cream cone.
Described cylinder as having two flat ends and one curved side.
Described cuboid faces as rectangles and cone as having a circular base and a point.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised naming 3D shapes and matching them with everyday objects. They explained shape features using examples such as a dice, bread packet, matchbox and ice-cream cone, and correctly described the cylinder’s two flat ends and curved side. They repeatedly asked for drawings or photos because the drawing option was not visible; at home, practise by finding and naming one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere around the house.
